post.originalText:
$0.19 OR $12.06 FOR THE SAME SHIP IN A BOTTLE. I'D PAY THE $12

that's what Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Opus 5.5 cost on one voxel prompt this week: a ship sailing through waves inside a bottle, with physics. Gemini is almost 64 times cheaper, so i put them side by side

i took the Gemini build of that prompt, ran Opus 5.5 against it once with no edits, and pressed the same 4 buttons at the same seconds on both

the Gemini bottle has more toys. a rainbow-ringed cork, a live roll and pitch counter, 18,128 active voxels. but the whole thing hangs in a black void, and its rogue wave is a white wall of blocks sliding across the water

the Opus bottle sits on a wooden stand on a table, under warm light, with the glass catching it. shake it and the water throws spray, the ship heels over, and the sand under the sea shows through the glass

both ships are fine. what you see in the first second is the room around them, and only one model built a room. one run each, so it's one data point, but it looks a lot like what $11.87 buys

the cheap one built the ship. the expensive one built the table it sits on.
